notes: `הַשְּׁאֵרִית` → *them that had escaped*: the present article takes the supplied *them that* under rule 41 and the noun takes the recast verb under rule 46. The competing reading gives the whole phrase to the noun and marks the article `unrepresented`.

The second `לְ` of `לוֹ וּלְבָנָיו` is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes one *to* for both members (rule 22); the resultative `לְ` of `לַעֲבָדִים` is `unrepresented` under rule 21, the copula going to `הָיָה`.
